hooks.name: Privacy guard on client code
hooks.description: Stops full-resolution images or the API key leaking into network calls from the app, and checks that saved OCR text is redacted.

action.prompt: Check the file you just saved against #product privacy principles: (1) full-resolution images, original photo-library URIs, or unscaled data URLs are never sent in any fetch/XHR — only a downscaled JPEG (long edge ≤ 1024, quality ~0.6) may go to /api/classify, and only when Smart sorting is on; (2) GEMINI_API_KEY is never referenced in client/app code and never placed in EXPO_PUBLIC_*; (3) any text saved to SQLite or sent to /api/ask passes through redact() first; (4) no console.log of OCR text or image payloads; (5) photo-library deletes must go through an explicit confirmation. If anything violates this, fix it and explain the fix in one line.
